ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65-70% low-intensity (dark/black) pixels and 30-35% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous patch on the medial-anterior region of the left lobe; vertical high-intensity linear striping on the central-medial region of the right lobe; dark pigmentation concentrated along trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 40-45 degrees; apex depth approximately 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the trailing edge of the right lobe; left lobe trailing edge displays moderate-frequency serrations with visible jagged disruptions near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature transitioning to a steep vertical sweep; concave inner lobe boundaries adjacent to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white and beige pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal tips of both lobes and along the upper leading edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical, high-intensity linear pixel streaks (rake marks) observed crossing the dark pigmentation on the interior surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the right distal tip causing significant topographical irregularity; a prominent jagged notch/irregularity on the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric pigmentation pattern where the left lobe contains a significantly larger contiguous area of high-intensity white pixels compared to the right lobe.
